topic: The abandoned contractor Instagram account. Everyone recognises it.

slides.subtitle: (we both know the account)
slides.scene: A phone lies face down and dusty on a garage shelf between a coil of wire and a half used tube of sealant, the screen dark. A thin layer of dust sits evenly across the back of it.

caption:
Almost every contractor has one. An Instagram account with nine posts, the last one from spring, three of them the same finished driveway.

It is not a discipline problem. Posting means thinking of something to say, making a picture, writing the words and remembering to do it, on a day you were already booked solid.

So it slides. Then it has slid so far that starting again feels embarrassing, so it slides further.

The fix is not trying harder. It is deciding once what you want to say, and having something else handle the rest.

This account posts twice a day. Nobody opens the app. I wrote up exactly how it is set up, including the parts that went wrong, and it is free.

Comment AUTOMATE and I will send it over.
